title: Credit risk: Data
description: Has what comes in changed? Drift of the 30 inputs against the reference of the champions (D-138, D-139). Input drift never alerts by itself (D-149).

list.name: subject
list.label: Variable
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT subject FROM monitoring.drift WHERE kind <> 'prediction' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT subject FROM monitoring.drift WHERE kind <> 'prediction' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: PSI of every input, month by month
panels.description: Green below 0.10, yellow to 0.25, red above: the usual reading of the PSI. Inputs only inform; the alerts are on the predictions (D-149).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT period::timestamptz AS time, subject AS metric, max(psi) AS value
FROM monitoring.drift
WHERE kind <> 'prediction' AND $__timeFilter(period)
GROUP BY period, subject
ORDER BY period

panels.title: PSI of ${subject}
panels.description: PSI against the reference, and the KS statistic for information (D-139).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT period::timestamptz AS time, psi AS "PSI", ks AS "KS (information)"
FROM monitoring.drift
WHERE subject = '$subject' AND $__timeFilter(period)
ORDER BY period

panels.title: Missing and new values of ${subject}
panels.description: Share of missing values, and of categories never seen or numbers outside the range of the reference.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT period::timestamptz AS time, null_share AS "missing share",
       new_values::double precision / NULLIF(rows, 0) AS "new values share"
FROM monitoring.drift
WHERE subject = '$subject' AND $__timeFilter(period)
ORDER BY period

panels.title: Largest input drift of the latest month
panels.description: The inputs that moved most in the last month measured.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT subject AS "variable", kind, round(psi::numeric, 3) AS "PSI",
       round(null_share::numeric, 3) AS "missing", new_values AS "new values",
       to_char(period, 'YYYY-MM') AS "month"
FROM monitoring.drift
WHERE kind <> 'prediction'
  AND period = (SELECT max(period) FROM monitoring.drift)
ORDER BY psi DESC
LIMIT 15
